eligibility.quote: Fixes a Humble to Jazzy regression: MPPI seeds rollouts from lagging odometry instead of its own last command

failed_conditions.quote: Fixes a Humble to Jazzy regression: MPPI seeds rollouts from lagging odometry instead of its own last command

loudness.quote: On Ubuntu 24.04, maximum speed is limited to \~0.25 m/s. ... 4. Observe `/cmd_vel` and compare the `linear.x` output on both OS versions.

resolution.quote: Tested: Ubuntu 24.04, MuJoCo sim. Our measurement on a simulated Ridgeback mecanum base, vx_max: 0.5: commanded speed 0.165 to 0.466 m/s; ground truth 0.138 to 0.452

notes: Verified this session: issue #5386 body (title 'MPPI Controller same YAML reaches 0.8 m/s on ROS2 Humble but only 0.25 m/s on ROS2 Jazzy', version 'ros-jazzy-navigation2 1.3.7-1noble.20250624.020544', YAML contains 'odom_topic: "/odometry/filtered"' which grounds the topic boundary and the unnamed provider unit); PR #6336 merged 2026-08-11 as 3f71f94b105b6731953a137561e8c27acc3e3acf with body 'We saw the same symptom class as #5386 and #5694 (that one reported 0.17 m/s and we similarly measured 0.173)'; upstream PR #5617 'add open loop option for MPPI' merged as 8dbc92910b020b19b9891849b3ee7cb92e1b3b03; #5214 maintainer comment (SteveMacenski) 'all controllers in Nav2 assume that your robot has properly setup robot controllers to be able to execute commands given.'; #5694 title 'Max Speed Capped at 0.17 m/s after ROS 2 Jazzy Migration (Nav2)'; reporter's closing comment 'It seems that the small acceleration value causes the vehicle to slow down.' and Mxilee's 'I had to increase ax_max to 15.0'. Eligibility at step 6: the failure depends on the lag of the consumed twist relative to the command — an assumption across the controller/odometry boundary (a peer whose twist tracked the command would not trigger it), so not internal; the fix adds a parameter and changes optimizer code, not wiring/build. Class 'other' is right: the defect is a timing/lag of a crossing value, covered neither by rate_shortfall (publishing rate) nor qos_deadline (enforced QoS policy). Resolution 'recommended' is right: fix merged but shown working only with a different peer (MuJoCo Ridgeback), and the reporter closed the issue on his own diagnosis.
